targets.purpose: Full RCS setup path for Codex with native agents, prompts, hooks, and runtime state.
notes: Owns generated .codex agents, prompts, hooks, and .rcs state wiring.

targets.purpose: Installable Codex plugin bundle for skill discovery plus plugin-scoped MCP/app metadata.
notes: Plugin bundle is a delivery lane, not the full runtime setup.
Setup-owned prompts, native-agent TOMLs, and hooks remain outside the plugin manifest.

targets.purpose: Future delivery lane for platforms that can consume canonical skills/guidance but do not share Codex runtime semantics one-to-one.
notes: Portable skills/guidance should come from canonical sources.
Setup-owned native agents and runtime hooks are not automatically portable one-to-one.

targets.purpose: Reference delivery for Cursor (rules, project skills, MCP clients) consuming canonical RCS skills and orchestration guidance without Codex-native runtime semantics.
notes: Treat Cursor-specific rules or skill mirrors as emitted artifacts from canonical sources.
Reference doc is the v0.2.0 delivery surface; optional future emitters should diff against canonical skills/.

targets.purpose: Versioned marketplace-facing package lane emitted from canonical plugin and package metadata.
notes: Marketplace packages are emitted artifacts, not second sources of truth.
Release and packaging workflows must keep this lane aligned with canonical package metadata.

targets.purpose: Reference delivery for editors and assistants that attach to RCS first-party MCP servers via stdio or marketplace wiring without the full Codex setup path.
notes: Hosts include any MCP client that can run rcs mcp-serve targets or consume published MCP manifests.
Boundary: MCP metadata is canonical in TypeScript generators; host-specific JSON is emitted, not hand-maintained in duplicate.

targets.purpose: RCS-owned adapter around OpenClaw notification, gateway, and lifecycle observation surfaces.
notes: Local observation is supported without over-claiming remote runtime health.

targets.purpose: RCS-owned foundation adapter lane for Hermes ACP, gateway, and session-store observation.
notes: Hermes currently ships as a foundation seam, not a full deep-control runtime.
